name: MMLongBench
intro: MMLongBench v3 是面向长上下文视觉语言模型的综合基准：它从 16 个公开来源数据集构造 13,331 个样本，覆盖视觉 RAG、NIAH、多样例 ICL、PDF 摘要和长文档问答，并用统一的文本/视觉词元规则生成 8K–128K 五档输入。论文评测 46 个模型，每档严格使用 4,050 个样例；其中 961 行 MMLongBench-Doc 是套件内预处理子集，不等同于独立发布的 1,082 题 MMLongBench-Doc。
org: HKUST, Tencent AI Seattle Lab, University of Edinburgh, Miniml.AI, NVIDIA AI Technology Center
build_method: 16个来源数据集的任务专属改造, 统一跨模态词元计数, 五档长度控制
metric: Accuracy, Substring Exact Match, DocVQA rule score, GPT-4o Fluency-F1
task_type: 视觉RAG, NIAH, 多样本ICL, PDF摘要, 长文档问答
eval_feature: 长上下文, 多模态, 跨模态
scale: 13,331个源样本，16个数据集，五类任务，五档长度；每档评测4,050例
task_type_en: Visual RAG, NIAH, Many-shot ICL, PDF summarization, Long-document VQA
build_method_en: Task-specific adaptation of 16 source datasets, unified cross-modal token counting, five controlled lengths
eval_feature_en: Long Context, Multimodal, Cross-modal Length Control, Task-specific Parsers
intro_en: MMLongBench v3 is a comprehensive benchmark for long-context vision-language models. It builds 13,331 source examples from 16 public datasets across Visual RAG, NIAH, Many-shot ICL, PDF summarization, and Long-document VQA, then materializes each example at five unified text-plus-vision lengths from 8K to 128K. The paper evaluates 46 models on exactly 4,050 cases per length. Its 961-row MMLongBench-Doc slice is a preprocessed suite component, not the separate 1,082-question MMLongBench-Doc release.

drawio_review_note: Evidence is pinned to arXiv:2505.10610v3 (PDF SHA-256 59bec597b521d551fe58f884647b99a7d863dcaf505e2895da4bf564a7f34006), paper-era code 69044ca7d6734b8820d1cbcc2da8bc65d35c88a7, and Hugging Face data 0c008eb69faccf58c96b03937eb378d234efd9cc; the retained CDN PDF is byte-identical to arXiv v3. The bilingual source diagrams preserve all five task-specific builders, exact 13,331/16-dataset scale, Llama2 plus 14x14-patch/2x2-unshuffle token counting, 8K/16K/32K/64K/128K lengths, and the 4,050-per-length denominator (900 VRAG + 2,250 NIAH + 400 ICL + 200 summarization + 300 DocVQA), yielding 20,250 runs per model. They distinguish the suite's preprocessed 961-row MMLongBench-Doc slice from the independent 1,082-row benchmark. Summarization uses GPT-4o sentence precision, atomic-claim recall, binary fluency, last-JSON parsing, skip-on-parse-failure aggregation, and retry-then-raise request behavior. Paper-v3 DocVQA directly parses Answer:/first-line output and applies format rules; the pinned repository's list implementation scores each gold element against the full parsed prediction, which differs from the paper's Greedy List Match. Code/data cards declare MIT, while upstream source-dataset licenses remain applicable. Later main-branch v1.1 adds an LLM DocVQA judge and vLLM support, so it is intentionally outside this reproducibility pin. Formal publication evidence [site-a11o-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 4405×1481 (English) and 4405×1481 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 4403×1479 and 4403×1479. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
